summary: I am trying to hold my self to a standard of only joining and supporting professional organizations with a commitment to #OpenScience. I am a public employee. Why should taxpayers pay twice to see my research? Hurts prestige. I am tenured. Privilege helps.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
I am trying to hold my self to a standard of only joining and supporting professional organizations with a commitment to #OpenScience.

I am a public employee. Why should taxpayers pay twice to see my research?

Hurts prestige. I am tenured. Privilege helps.
